question: Indian Railway was introduced in the year __________.
solution:
The correct answer is **__1853__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The railway system in India was introduced on **16 April 1853**.
 
• The first passenger train in India ran between** Bombay (now Mumbai) and Thane**, covering a distance of 34 kilometers.
 
• **Lord Dalhousie** was the Governor General of India in 1853.
 
• The** headquarters** of Indian Railways is located at** Rail Bhavan in New Delhi, India**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Indian Railways is the **largest rail network in Asia** and the **second-largest globally**.
 
• The **Shree Siddharoodha Swamiji Railway Station in Hubballi, Karnataka,** holds the Guinness World Record for the longest railway platform in the world, measuring **1,507 meters.**
 
• **The Vivek Express** has the longest run on the Indian Railways network in terms of distance and time, traveling 4,273 km.
 
• The oldest working Indian locomotive is the **Fairy Queen,** which operates with a steam engine and is still in use.
 
• The mascot of Indian Railways is **"Bholu", the guard elephant,** which was designed by the National Institute of Design and unveiled on 16th April 2002.
 
• Indian Railways operates a mixed fleet of 13,169 passenger trains and more than 8,000 freight trains daily.
